result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on converging SV-03-01 in the client explicit-version selection path, confirming the bounded workspace-reload fallback behavior against the Story 3 client design/test-plan expectations, and rerunning the requested gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `selectArtifactVersion` now reloads the review workspace on `ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` / `REVIEW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` via `reloadReviewWorkspaceSelection()` instead of immediately collapsing into `reviewWorkspace.error` (`apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1019-1247`). The new client test drives the stale explicit-version 404 path and asserts that process context remains visible, the page shows bounded unavailable target copy, and the route keeps the explicit `versionId` (`tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts:303-393`). That matches the Story 3 client design fallback (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/tech-design-client.md:244-275`) and the test-plan obligation for `TC-3.4c` (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/test-plan.md:279-285`).

mockOrShimAuditFindings: `apps/platform/server/app.ts:154-182` still carries the repo-wide `NullPlatformStore` fallback when live Convex config is absent; the Story 3 follow-up did not change that existing shim behavior.
No new production-path mocks, shims, or fake adapters were introduced in the touched Story 3 follow-up path; the changes stay inside real client review-selection logic and test-only harnesses.
additionalObservations: Client service coverage increased from 235 to 236 tests, with the added stale explicit-version fallback case covering the prior blocker directly.

`guard:no-test-changes` and `test:e2e` remain scaffolded skip commands, so the substantive follow-up evidence still comes from format/lint/typecheck/build plus convex, server, client, package, and integration suites.
